name: Ho Chi Minh City to My Tho
summary: The provincial roads page says 70 km and about 1 hour on the Trung Lương expressway. A ticket page says 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. There is no passenger train. Fares are check on arrival.

modes.note: Print both. The provincial roads page: 70 km and about 1 hour by bus on the Ho Chi Minh City–Trung Lương expressway. The ticket page: 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours toward Sài Gòn. Fares are check on arrival. The bus station is on đường Ấp Bắc. A street number was not printed.
The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway stopped in 1958. A Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line is in pre-feasibility and does not name a Mỹ Tho station. Do not plan a train.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City to My Tho — 70 km or 66 km
seoDescription: 70 km and about 1 hour on the provincial page, or 66 km and 1.7 hours on a ticket page. The return is 67 km and 1.7 hours. No passenger train. Fares are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you take the train to My Tho?
faqs.a: No. The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway stopped in 1958. The planned Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ line does not name a Mỹ Tho station.
Keep both. The provincial roads page says 70 km and about 1 hour. A ticket page says 66 km and 1.7 hours toward Mỹ Tho, and 67 km and 1.7 hours back. Fares are check on arrival.
